name: Aberrant Form
body:
School transmutation; Level psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living touched
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The caster transforms a willing creature into an aberration. Its form shifts into a hideous mockery of its natural state. The creature’s type changes to aberration, and it gains a +1 natural armor bonus to AC for every four levels the caster has, up to a maximum of +5. While the spell persists the target also takes a penalty to Diplomacy checks a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the bonus granted to natural armor.
